Portrait of Cui Jian

Cui Jian, known as the father of Chinese rock, poses against a vibrant blue background. He wears a black jacket with red accents over a dark shirt, hands tucked into his pockets. His white cap, marked by a red star, and his serious gaze capture his enduring rock spirit.

This image accompanies the announcement of his December 21, 2024 concert at Chengdu Dong’an Lake Sports Park Multipurpose Gymnasium. Tickets range from 380 to 1180 yuan, and fans can expect to hear classics like “Flower House Girl,” “Fake Monk,” and “Let Me Go Wild in the Snow.”

Cui Jian Portrait

This black-and-white studio portrait presents Cui Jian, the influential Chinese rock musician born in 1961. His contemplative gaze and casual attire reflect the era when he transitioned from classical trumpet player to rock pioneer. The image’s simplicity underscores his role as a cultural icon who challenged musical norms in 1980s China.

Cui Jian Portrait

A striking black-and-white portrait captures Chinese rock musician Cui Jian partially hidden behind a metal door. His arms are crossed, and he wears a light baseball cap and dark t-shirt, creating a strong contrast against the textured industrial wall. The high-contrast lighting accentuates his thoughtful gaze and the gritty surface of the backdrop.

sources.description:
Cui Jian Apple Music Cover Art

Chinese rock pioneer Cui Jian is featured on his Apple Music artist page cover art. He stands casually against a neutral backdrop, wearing a gray t-shirt, patterned shorts, and a cap, with an electric guitar slung over his shoulder. The minimalist portrait underscores his laid-back style and rock musician persona.

The accompanying Apple Music page invites fans to listen to his top songs and albums, highlighting iconic tracks such as "花房姑娘" and "一无所有." This promotional image serves as a gateway for listeners to explore Cui Jian’s influential catalog on the streaming platform.
